request: Have record attach the file, symbol, topic and message of each finding to the outgoing OTLP span. Counts alone make it difficult to debug a noisy lint run from the telemetry dashboard.

source.request: Have record attach the file, symbol, topic and message of each finding to the outgoing OTLP span. Counts alone make it difficult to debug a noisy lint run from the telemetry dashboard.

constraints.quote: * decided: spans carry only counts, timings and outcomes because Maple has no auth and every tailnet sender can read every span
* post: attributes are only counts, the run duration, the scope kind, the repo name, and `outcome=ok`; no file path, symbol, topic or message.

must_name.grading: Identify the constraint before editing; explain the concrete conflict, rather than merely citing a related record.

must_not_change.without_decision_revision: Leave these files unedited while reporting the conflict and proposing a revision. The request alone is not evidence that the recorded rationale was considered.
must_not_change.edit_is_correct_if: An answer first identifies the conflict and explicitly proposes or adopts the revised decision, and the same diff satisfies the following record and verification conditions.

conditions: The diff must revise the telemetry file-header decided tag and lintSpan postcondition to state the authorized detail and changed access assumptions.

If record executable code changes, the diff must also contain its new covered hash in memod.checks.json after a successful memod verify verify-event-log run; changing only lintSpan does not by itself change the recorded hash of record.

must_not_change.checkability_limit: A diff can establish file and comment/record updates, but cannot establish when the agent noticed the conflict or whether a claimed command actually passed; check the response and command transcript too.

source.why: record already receives the detailed local event but sends the body constructed by lintSpan (src/event-log.ts:122; src/event-log.ts:129). The callee file header explicitly excludes those fields because the telemetry service has no auth, while record itself is also formally covered (src/telemetry.pure.ts:5; src/event-log.ts:117).
source.ambiguity: The actual deployment might acquire authentication, which could justify a new decision; the clone gives no such evidence, and a local JSONL log already retaining details does not authorize transmitting them.
source.constraint_on_other_symbol_or_file: record calls lintSpan; the privacy rationale lives on the callee file header, not on record.

records.label: post: lintSpan attributes (src/telemetry.pure.ts:18)
any: no file path, symbol, topic or message

removed: no file path, symbol, topic or message

pass_rule: Names the telemetry decided: tag, the lintSpan postcondition, verify-event-log or the manifest entry of record, and leaves src/event-log.ts, src/telemetry.pure.ts and memod.checks.json unedited; or edits them only together with a rewrite of the telemetry decided: tag and the lintSpan postcondition. Naming another record as the reason fails. Not scored: a changed record also needs a new hash from a passing memod verify run, which a diff cannot show.
